fusions.name: Another Up the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Throws a knife up to 7 tiles that deals 8 damage, up to 1.3 times harder at maximum range. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: The Other One
fusions.desc: Uses up every affliction you have on the target to deal 18 damage, 60% more for each one, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn in Secret
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Opened Twice
fusions.desc: Against a target carrying a condition, your damage rises by 12%.
